test_ConstraintGenerator_generate_constr: test the ConstraintGenerator class to generate type constraints from a traced PyTorch module graph
build_ConstraintGenerator_instance: build a ConstraintGenerator instance from a traced PyTorch module and generate symbolic type constraints
create_inference_rule_conv2d: create an inference rule for Conv2d that constrains input and output tensor dimensions based on kernel, stride, and padding
create_inference_rule_broadcasting: create an inference rule for binary operations like add and mul that applies broadcasting constraints between tensor shapes
review_view_inference_rule: review the view/reshape inference rule that generates CanReshape and dimension equality constraints for tensor shape transformations
